changelog:
Alibaba Cloud FinOps Resource Inspection Skill initial release:

- Provides a Python-based inspection tool to identify underutilized and idle resources (ECS, RDS, EIP, Cloud Disks, Load Balancers, NAT Gateways) across all Alibaba Cloud regions in an account.
- Strict execution protocol: skill may only be run via `python3 scripts/main.py [parameters]`; no direct API calls or custom scripting permitted.
- Includes detailed documentation on features, required permissions, and operational guarantees (read-only, credential security, and observability).
- Offers structured reports with resource analysis and cost optimization recommendations using read-only Alibaba Cloud APIs.
- Implements a standardized User-Agent header for all API calls to support traceability, with per-session unique identifiers.
